body.x: SEOUL, Korea (AVING) -- <Visual News> LG Electronics launched its ultra-thin premium notebook pc 'X300 Series' in Korea market, which was unveiled at CES 2010 in Las Vegas. Boasting a collection of refined and elegant design features, the LG X300 weighs only 970g and measures 17.6mm thickness.
Adopting a sleek but wide 11.6-inch frameless LCD screen, it also has a pebble-style keyboard and a borderless touchpad featuring hidden lighting and tactile feedback.

The LG X300 is powered by a 2.0 GHz Intel Menlow platform with up to 2GB memory and a 64GB solid state drive (SSD) instead of a hard disk. The X300 comes with a spare 2-cell battery pack to provide up to seven hours' operation.
